## Overview
### Introduction to Llama Guard 3 8B
The Llama Guard 3 8B model, provided by Meta, is a budget-friendly and open-source solution released on 2024-07-23. This model boasts an architecture that supports a range of capabilities, including text generation, moderation, safety filtering, and function calling. With its context window of 8,192 tokens and maximum output of 8,192 tokens, Llama Guard 3 8B is well-suited for various applications, including chat, text generation, coding, analysis, and summarization.

### Technical Strengths and Use-Cases
Llama Guard 3 8B's main strengths lie in its ability to handle text-based tasks efficiently, with pricing set at $0.2 per 1M tokens for both input and output. The model's capabilities, such as json mode, streaming, and structured outputs, make it a versatile tool for developers. However, it's essential to note that Llama Guard 3 8B may not be the best fit for general chat or coding tasks that require complex reasoning. The model's performance is backed by benchmarks, including an MMLU score of 80.0 and an LMSYS Arena ELO of 1200. With its budget-friendly pricing and open-source nature, Llama Guard 3 8B is an attractive option for developers looking to integrate AI capabilities into their applications.
